supersedes: vnext_strict_retrieval_calibration_v04.json; v04 stopped at 12/24 because its label was structurally empty
amendment_reason: Candidate-identity scrambling is a negative-control distribution, not a null in which every observed programme must exceed every unrelated scrambled programme. Max-over-bank scrambling therefore erased the retrieval labels. This version separates effect retrieval from selected-list null diagnostics.
purpose: Development-only calibration of frozen raw multimodal search with separate regular and higher-order held-out effect retrieval endpoints.

candidate_bank.construction: deterministic metadata-only sampling before support targets or query payload are read

methods.ebm_program_ranker: main-effect EBM over exactly the compiled program columns
methods.gbm_program_ranker: support-only permutation importance over exactly the compiled program columns
methods.random_program_ranker: seeded uniform ordering of the identical program bank

effect_labels.regular: B_known held-out gain > 0, patient-bootstrap lower confidence bound > 0, and at least 60% held-out patients positive
effect_labels.higher_order: regular plus held-out gain beyond the strongest legal proper-subset decomposition > 0, decomposition bootstrap lower confidence bound > 0, and at least 60% held-out patients positive

negative_controls.multiplicity: max-statistic family-wise p-values are reported for each effect label as a strict secondary diagnostic; they do not redefine AP/AUROC labels
negative_controls.selected_list_reporting: for each method's top 10 and top 20, report effect-label yield and the number that also clear both strict null controls

interpretation: A test-role cache must repeat this unchanged evaluator for paper-facing comparative claims. Individual biological discoveries are separately tested under the predeclared proposal budget with appropriate family-level correction; the historical and blind cohorts remain excluded from calibration.
